g.text: truST Simulation Plant System: Scan And Ownership Boundaries
Model-structure teaching project: the existing continuous state-space
model owns water and probe deviations, input delay and initial history.
Binding offsets preserve the 35 C / 75% operating point; model-coordinate
actuator limits map to physical 0..100% heating. ST reads both native
temperatures through ordinary PLC inputs and does not emulate the probe.
Applied feedback shares byte-range ownership checks with
plant, coupling and physics inputs. Reset and fault paths
retain one atomic next-scan publication boundary.
Random streams derive from master seed,
Execution buffers are allocated at activation.
Validity faults roll back; bounds are not safety interlocks.
resolve omitted starting state; preserve omission on save
explicit example choice and replacement review
same canonical draft; no browser physics
then symbolic feedback, all values checked first
